Emma Johnson's Hawaii Packing List
Destination: Hawaii
Dates: June 10th - June 20th, 2024

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Swimwear (multiple suits for rotation)
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Beach towel
- Sandals/water shoes
- Dry bag for water activities
- Snorkel mask (or rent at Hanauma Bay)
- Waterproof phone case

OUTDOOR & HIKING:
- Hiking shoes/sneakers
- Daypack/backpack
- Reusable water bottle
- Hat/cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses
- Lightweight breathable clothing
- Rain jacket (just in case)

DINING & ENTERTAINMENT:
- Casual outfits for daily wear
- One dressy outfit for Luau
- Light cardigan or cover-up (for air-conditioned restaurants)

TRAVEL ESSENTIALS:
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight tickets, hotel reservations)
- Camera
- Phone charger & portable battery
- Credit cards/cash
- Any medications
- Toiletries & personal care items

COMFORT ITEMS:
- Sleepwear
- Flip flops
- Light pajamas
- Eye mask & earplugs (for flights/adjusting to time zone)

NOTES:
- June 10: Departure
- June 11: Waikiki Beach
- June 12: Hanauma Bay Snorkeling
- June 13: Diamond Head Hike
- June 14: Pearl Harbor Visit
- June 15: North Shore Road Trip
- June 16: Polynesian Cultural Center Luau
- June 17: Hotel Spa Day
- June 18: Kailua Beach Kayaking
- June 19: Ala Moana Shopping
- June 20: Departure

Emma Johnson's Hawaii Packing List
Destination: Hawaii | Dates: June 10th - June 20th, 2024

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Swimwear (multiple)
- Reef-safe sunscreen
- Beach towel
- Snorkeling gear (or rent at Hanauma Bay)
- Waterproof phone case
- Flip flops/beach sandals
- Kayaking gear (or rent at Kailua Beach)

HIKING & OUTDOORS:
- Hiking shoes/sneakers
- Hiking gear (backpack, water bottle)

- Sunglasses

CASUAL ATTIRE:
- Casual outfits (light, breathable fabrics)
- Light jacket or sweater (for air-conditioned places)
- Sleepwear
- Underwear and socks

ESSENTIALS:
- Camera
- Travel documents (passport, ID, tickets)
- Phone charger
- Medications
- Toiletries

SPECIAL EVENTS:
- Luau-appropriate attire (Hawaiian shirt or casual dress)

MISCELLANEOUS:

- Cash/credit cards
- Book or entertainment for travel
